original_ai_output.title_zh: 南非反移民抗议者在德班集会，誓言继续游行
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南非反移民抗议者周三在德班街头举行反对非法移民的新一轮示威，数百人参加。反移民组织“March and March”将9月30日设为无证移民离境的非正式最后期限，并在多个省份发起示威。过去数月南非反移民运动持续升温，并导致针对外国公民的暴力事件。

location.raw_text: the South African city of Durban

key_facts.fact: 数百人周三在南非德班街头举行反对非法移民的抗议活动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Hundreds of people took to the streets of the South African city of Durban on Wednesday in a new protest against illegal immigration.

key_facts.fact: 反移民组织March and March将9月30日设为无证移民离境的非正式最后期限
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The anti-migrant group March and March had set the date of September 30 as an unofficial deadline for undocumented immigrants to leave the country.

key_facts.fact: 该运动在多个省份发起示威
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The movement staged demonstrations across several provinces.

key_facts.fact: 过去数月南非反移民运动升温，导致针对外国公民的暴力事件
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: South Africa has faced an intense anti-immigration campaign over the past several months, leading to episodes of violence against foreign citizens.

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Africanews）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
报道未提供示威具体人数、伤亡或逮捕情况
